flags.message: Docket date oddity on the upstream record, no effect on scoring: the snapshot's first proceedings entry (petition filed) is dated Mar 23 2026 while DocketedDate is July 17, 2026 and the petition itself is signed June 2026; the event's opened_at follows the docketed date. Noted by one candidate as well. Recorded so a maintainer can see it if the entry-date vs docketed-date gap matters to any date-keyed cut.
